acs.text_first_line: AC1 A missed installment starts the cure period as a durable timer
AC2 A matched installment advances the plan
AC3 A partial payment holds the shortfall on the plan
AC4 A late payment inside the cure period ends the wait early
AC5 A cure period that passes unpaid breaks the plan
AC6 No rule version in force is a refusal
AC7 Nothing moves without its record
AC8 The plan consequence is read under the caller's right

ops_provided: GET /api/recovery/treatment/v1/treatments/{treatmentId} (shape declared by RWB-S2-E3001-CON; this story serves the plan-consequence elements: state, installments paid, shortfall, outcome, decision record)
ops_consumed: RWB-P8-E2027-CON (rwb-payment): the match consequence of a business date for a case and its plans; operation name and payload members Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2705; ASM-4487)
RWB-P3-E1042-CON (rwb-case): CURE_PERIOD_DAYS and restructure.max_breaks at their version; operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2706; ASM-4488)
RWB-P3-E1043-CON (rwb-case): LOV-TRT-OUTCOME at its version; operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2706; ASM-4488)
RWB-P7-E1073-CON (rwb-decision): the RES rule package version in force for the business date; operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2706; ASM-4488)
workflows: TreatmentWorkflow (queue rwb-treatment; activities EvaluateRules and RecordAndApply; one durable cure timer)
